placements.title: Release gates move from advice to binding rule
placements.frame: What must a release gate establish before it binds every deploy, and what prior incident justifies making it binding?
placements.why: The ReleaseGateBinding position holds the settled deploy requirement (a signed release manifest for Meridian deploys, scoped to staging and production, owned by Quinton Fairweather) and the stated justification (two unsigned artifacts reaching staging last quarter). Together they make a binding gate and its evidential basis a subject future envelopes can keep feeding. The leaf is minted because no existing leaf is present in the graph structure.
